utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Vik. I think Cleo mentioned she's got some tools and parts ready for that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, that's great! I know Ira and Jules are planning to come too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, who else is coming? I thought it was just us.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, I just heard that Rosa's cleared her whole Saturday for the drive, and Oren's planning to come early too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I've got the map of repair spots ready for Rosa and Jules to coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's perfect, Opal. With Rosa free all day and Oren coming early, we'll be in great shape to tackle those spots.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, are you free to lend a hand at the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, maybe? What time is it and what do you need me to do exactly?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's from 10 AM to 4 PM, and we could really use someone with your plumbing skills to help fix a few leaky faucets.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Heard Rosa's bringing the tool kits and Opal has a map of the spots.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, but I'm ready to help. Got a wrench in the trunk if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, you're here! I'll check with Rosa on the tool kits and Opal for the map, then we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a toolkit and some spare parts ready for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is the repair drive really this Saturday? I thought it was next weekend.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No, it's this Saturday. I've had the calendar marked for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus! I've been mapping out who's got what for the repair drive—guess who has a soldering iron they've never used?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I hope Leo knows how to use it better than I do—he's fixing my blender next week!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, so Leo's the one with the soldering iron? I'll add him to my map then! You're lucky he's got skills.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Tess is bringing her old toaster, do you have anything to contribute?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got some tools I can donate, Eli and I gathered a bunch from our sheds.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, tools are always needed. Can you bring them to the community center this Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm glad Tess is helping. We're meeting Sam at 2 to plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good thing Dane has backup plans, but Tess's toaster might cause issues.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'll make sure Sam and I have a solid plan for Tess's toaster too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I'll be there early with my toolbox, ready for that toaster Nell's bringing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll do my best to come by too, but I might be a little late.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries, Uli. Even if you're late, we'll get started. Just glad you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Tess is bringing her old toaster. Hope it can be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm bringing my old toaster too. At least Oren will be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, Oren knows his way around small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the blender and toaster. Let's see what else comes in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great start! I'll let the rest of the block know we're collecting small appliances now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I think it's actually on Sunday, not Saturday! I'll be there with the tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks for the correction, see you Sunday then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane! The repair drive is a neighborhood event where we fix broken items for folks. I've already set things up and gathered tools with Eli.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds great, Sam! What can I help with—I'm handy with small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is the repair drive definitely this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it's this Saturday. I've mapped out all the spots that need repairs and I'll share the map with Rosa and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just making sure. Gus will be there with his tools?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for Saturday's repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, Saturday is still on! I've got a list of skills and tools from the neighbors, so it should be a productive day.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Did Ira get the parts ordered?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I heard Rosa has cleared her whole Saturday for the repair drive; that's great dedication.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, she's a big help. We'll need it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: And Oren said he'll try to come early too, so we should have a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm planning to bring an old toaster to the repair drive. Are you bringing anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure yet—need to double-check that Dane's backup plans are solid first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I see. Well, hope everything works out with Dane.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there on Saturday, though I might need to leave early.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for understanding.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So just to confirm, Ira and Jules are both coming to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I think so, but I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check with Ira and Jules directly to be certain.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just a heads up, Tess is bringing her old toaster to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, I've got a toolkit and some spare parts ready. That toaster should be fixable.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll make sure to save it for you. Do we have any other appliances coming in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, I'm mapping out who has what tools for the repair drive. I've got a soldering iron—do you need it for anything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I think we've got that covered in the tool kits I'm bringing, but thanks for offering!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, just making sure! So, I'm doing the Saturday afternoon shift—are you signed up for that slot too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard Rosa's bringing the tool kits, and Opal has a map of the spots.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought my toolbox! And I'll be there early.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that'll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're getting the whole neighborhood together!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard. Tess is bringing her old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, a toaster! That sounds perfect. I'll bring my wonky blender, and we can make a breakfast station!
